letters: Dear friend, {PLACE} isn't the same without you. Come back to {CITY} soon! {NAME}
Hi! I sat at our table at {PLACE} today and thought of you. Where are you now? {NAME}
{CITY} is rainy and slow. Remember {PLACE}? I still laugh about it. Write back! {NAME}
Guess who asked about you at {PLACE}? Everyone. Safe travels. {NAME}
Found a postcard of {PLACE} and had to send you something. Don't forget us in {CITY}. {NAME}
Quick note: I'm learning to cook, and it's your fault, after {PLACE}. {NAME}
